title: TONA SIAN HUTA - Opera & Konser Musik
description: Tona Sian Huta is a cultural performance that brings back the sounds of your hometown through typical Batak performing arts. This event combines Batak Opera performances that are full of stories and traditional values ​​with modern and traditional Batak music concerts, presenting an emotional, magnificent and authentic experience. Held directly in Batak Land, this event was designed as a homecoming stage for the Batak diaspora spread across various cities in Indonesia and abroad. Through stories, music and the atmosphere of their hometown, Tona Sian Huta becomes a nostalgic bridge that connects migrants with their cultural roots. More than just a show, Tona Sian Huta is expected to become a cultural magnet that encourages Batak migrants to return to visit Batak Land—bringing their family, friends and community. Thus, this event not only celebrates Batak cultural identity, but also opens up great opportunities for the development of cultural tourism in Batak Land, attracting tourists from within and outside the country to experience firsthand the richness of Batak traditions.
location: Gedung Jetun Silangit

title: Drama Musikal Negeri dalam Senandung Rinai
description:
The Country Musical Drama in Senandung Rinai is children's theater which contains movements and songs packaged in modern fairy tales. Tells the story of Rinai, a king's daughter who was expelled by her father and lost to the land of animals. Rinai wants to return to her country and make her father aware that he will no longer abuse his people. The fairies helped Rinai return to her country and managed to wake her father up after a disaster occurred in the country and he had to make offerings so that the disaster would stop. Rinai was willing to sacrifice herself in this offering, but in the end the fairies saved her, and the disaster disappeared through the falling rain. All creatures are happy.
This drama is filled with cheerful and funny children's songs. The children's cute behavior is an extraordinary attraction at this show. So don't miss this show, order tickets immediately before they run out.

description:
The Happy Project is a community and project that was born and grew from our great interest as young adults in the performing arts. We feel that performing arts has the potential to become a 'home' or place for us to take shelter in the midst of a complex adult life filled with limitations in expression. Many of us feel too involved in our daily lives filled with busyness and individual responsibilities, which is sometimes tiring, but also turns out to be worth laughing at and expressing without limits.
Said
happy
or happy to be chosen as the title as a form of our appreciation for the simple feelings we feel when we process and dynamic together in the world of performing arts. Not only do we bring this joy to the stage, we also hope that we can transmit this joy to the wider audience who come and enjoy our shows.
Through
The Happy Project 2026: A Musical Concert
, we humbly invite performing arts lovers to witness our first project which was born from our determination and interest as a simple community that lasts as long as it lasts. Come, sit down, and share a little taste of this simple joy with us!

title: Piano Recital by Petrick Kluivert
description: Petrick Kluivert Piano Recital presents an intimate evening of classical piano, featuring works by R. Schumann, J. Brahms, F. Chopin, and S. Rachmaninoff. This recital explores the many shades of becoming: innocence, longing, inner conflict, tenderness, and emotional maturity. Through Schumann’s Abegg Variations, Brahms’ Klavierstücke Op. 76, Chopin’s Polonaise-Fantaisie Op. 61, and Rachmaninoff’s Piano Sonata Op. 36 No. 2, Petrick invites the audience into a musical journey shaped by lyricism, virtuosity, and deep personal reflection. Born in the 90's, Petrick began studying piano at the age of 9. He trained under Imelda and Teo Minaroy before continuing his studies at Yayasan Pendidikan Musik Jakarta, including the Pre-Conservatory Program, under the guidance of renowned Indonesian pianists Gita Bayuratri, Levi Gunardi, and Aisha Sudiarso Pletscher. He later continued private studies with Iswargia Renardi Sudarno, acclaimed Indonesian pedagogue, conductor, and Director of Jakarta Conservatory of Music. During his musical journey, Petrick received several recognitions, including the YPM Young Artist Award in 2015 and 2017, The Most Outstanding Performance Award from 2013 to 2015, 1st Prize at Bandung National Piano Competition, Finalist at Jakarta Conservatory of Music Boston Piano Competition, and Grand Finalist at Indonesia Steinway Youth Piano Competition. He has also participated in masterclasses with distinguished musicians, including German pianist and pedagogue Josef Anton Scherrer. Join Petrick for an evening of powerful, poetic, and deeply expressive piano music at Balai Recital Kertanegara.
location: Balai Resital Kertanegara
